title: Everyone Knows What It's Like When Nothing Goes Right, but What Do I Do When That Happens? Why, It's Obvious! I Run and Scream My Head Off!
overview: Rein is unceremoniously kicked out of the Beast's Fangs, so he decides to become an adventurer.

title: The Enhanced Clothes I Was Wearing Were Destroyed by a Devastating Blow, and a Traumatized Girl in Casual Clothes Hit Me With All Her Might.
overview: With help from legendary adventurer Lily Flambert, Rein defeats a mid-level dragon.

title: When I Went to Apologize With a Friend Who Was a Shut-In for Two Years, We Were Unexpectedly Served Apple Bunnies, so I Think She’s Been Forgiven.
overview: When Rein and Lily return to town, they meet Margaret, whose sister once adventured with Lily.

title: There’s Something I’ve Learned From Ending Up Naked Twice... When You’re Naked, You Get Bitten Twice.
overview: Rein's old guild learns he dispelled their enchantments, and Cornelius hires an assassin.

title: A Girl Who Wants You to Know She Really Can Cook Despite the Lack of Cooking Scenes Draws and Wreathes Her Sword in Flames.
overview: Margaret loses her mind after reading a note that reads, "Lily Flambert killed us."

title: You’re Persistent, Girl... You Haven’t Changed at All, and You’re Powerless to Do Anything Again... But Still, I Am Lily Flambert!
overview: Lily overcomes her fear of fighting, while Mirabelle struggles with her own change of heart.

title: I’ve Never Been to That Bakery Before, so I’ll Take This Opportunity to Stuff My Face With Melon Bread and Walk a Dog, Wahoo.
overview: Margaret is excited to join the Blue Crystals, but she shuts down again when she believes she's been mislead.

title: That's Opium! Nobody's Going to Argue with You, and I'm Sure You Feel Like You've Gotten Stronger! But That's Not Steroids... You're Not Actually the Slightest Bit Stronger!
overview: Rein and Lily visit Mirabelle's home to recruit her for a high-paying quest.
